card.name: Words leading up to alarm or bell
card.fires_on: Small words like 'the', 'an', 'of' or a verb like 'sounding' right before an expected 'alarm' or 'bell', as in sounding the alarm or the ringing of an alarm clock.

modes.label: Sounding the alarm
modes.description: The word 'the' or 'sounding' in the idiom about raising an alarm or warning.
modes.example: Dr. Lovejoy is sounding<< the>> alarm that global biodiversity is facing unprecedented threats

modes.label: Alarm clock or hand-bell sounds
modes.description: Linking words before a ringing alarm clock or bell is named.
modes.example: By Pure Matters Like the ringing of<< an>> alarm clock, a cluster headache announces itself

modes.label: Hearing a signal
modes.description: Words right after hear or sound of, where an alarm or bell is expected.
modes.example: "I know I won't hear<< the>> alarm tomorrow morning.

card.writes: It pushes the model to predict bell, horn and alarm-type sound words next.
card.plain: It fires on the small words just before 'alarm' or 'bell', when the text is about a ringing or warning sound.
